name: @devpro/chade
description: Snapshot the configuration of a system, files, installed applications, extensions, services and repositories, into a git repository, one folder per machine

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ../ui && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/bin.js "--banner:js=import { createRequire as bundleRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = bundleRequire(import.meta.url);" && cp -r ../ui/dist dist/ui

author: Bertrand THOMAS
